findings.summary: SBL_E_DEFERRED_KIND is raised but absent from sbl_core/errors.py ERROR_CODES
findings.detail: The candidate raises SBLError("SBL_E_DEFERRED_KIND", ...) but ERROR_CODES in sbl_core/errors.py does not contain that code, and errors.py was not in this brief's write scope. A caller validating codes against ERROR_CODES would treat a real refusal as unregistered. Not invented here: recorded, no API added.
findings.owner_action: add SBL_E_DEFERRED_KIND to ERROR_CODES in a scoped change

findings.summary: stale non-editable sbl_core copy in site-packages
findings.detail: venv site-packages holds sbl_core/m03_routing.py with sha256 FDB62AF... (the pre-apply file), so the installed distribution does not see this change. The pytest run is unaffected because rootdir precedes site-packages on sys.path, but any run from a directory outside the repo root would import the stale module. A probe launched from a temp dir did exactly that.
findings.owner_action: reinstall the package (editable) before running any out-of-tree entry point
